messages:
ingrid: tossing an idea for a hybrid compact projection: per-prefix 1-byte confidence + 3-byte compact token + SLA-class hint. projection drives cheap eviction/admission; any low-confidence case spills to full-lease. goal: trade tiny extra compute for far fewer false positives and SLA-aware fairness.

ben: high-level: confidence byte = 0..255 meaning how recently/robustly the projection was validated?
ingrid: yes. we derive confidence from recent validations and access pattern stability. new prefix starts at low confidence. on every successful stitch with full-lease we bump confidence; on any mismatch we reset and backoff.

ravi: SLA-class hint? does that mean we bias eviction by customer tier? risky from fairness POV but pragmatic.
ingrid: exactly. hint = one of {plat, prod, dev} encoded in 2 bits. eviction scoring multiplies raw score by a SLA-weight (plat gets multiplier 0.5, prod 1.0, dev 1.5). keeps critical tenants warmer.

marcos: two ops questions: 1) how do we avoid long tail when many low-confidence prefixes cause full-lease storms? 2) rollout safety?
ingrid: answers: 1) we cap full-lease consults via a bucketed rate-limiter and prioritized by SLA; if cap hit, admission falls back to conservative (no-evict) decision. 2) feature-flag, start read-only metrics, then soft-canary for small tenants.

ben: can you sketch the compact layout?
ingrid: sure:
```
// packed 4 bytes per prefix summary
// token: 24 bits, confidence: 8 bits (0-255), sla stored separately in tenant map
struct CompactProj { u32_token_low24; u8_confidence; }
```

ravi: stitching semantics? when we stitch we compare token and tenant id and then either accept or mark mismatch. on mismatch we record a diag event and set confidence=0 and set backoff timer for that prefix.

marcos: metrics to gate on: projection_eviction_success_rate, full_consult_qps, mismatch_rate, eviction_churn_by_sla. gate thresholds: mismatch_rate < 0.05% and full_consult_qps < N per node for 1h.

ben: what about deletes / re-create? token reuse could confuse confidence.
ingrid: we include a per-node epoch salt in the token derivation. after major GC/compaction we bump salt -> old tokens become mismatches (low confidence) and get validated before reuse. also plan to bump tenant-level token on explicit rename.

ravi: rollout knobs: confidence_thresholds per-sla, full_consult_cap, per-prefix backoff base (default 1m, exp backoff to 30m), emergency_kill_switch to force-full. ops-bot: please ensure kill-switch can be triggered via console API.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag hybrid-projection canary=7% cluster="cachepool-b" (requested by ingrid).

ingrid: next steps: write RFC with correctness argument + backpressure math, implement prototype in branch `proj/hybrid-confidence`, add dashboards for the metrics marcos listed, and run a 24h smoke canary. booking a 30m sync Thu 9am to review. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
